titleZh: 强强联手|望潮创新×杭州领擎机器人，共拓智慧清洁新赛道
titleEn: Powerful Collaboration | Wangchao Innovation × Hangzhou Lingqing Robotics, Joining Forces to Explore a New Path in Smart Cleaning
excerptZh: 近日，杭州望潮创新机器人有限公司与杭州领擎机器人有限公司正式签署战略合作协议。双方立足智慧物业数字化转型趋势，依托万物云生态资源，围绕数据互通、产品供给、技术共建、资源共享开展深度合作，携手推进智能清洁机器人场景落地，解锁智慧空间服务全新模式。
excerptEn: Recently, Hangzhou Wangchao Innovation Robotics Co., Ltd. and Hangzhou Lingqing Robotics Co., Ltd. officially signed a strategic cooperation agreement. Based on the trend of digital transformation in smart property, the two sides will leverage the resources of the Wanwu Cloud ecosystem and carry out in-depth cooperation in data connectivity, product supply, joint technology development, and resource sharing, working together to promote the implementation of smart cleaning robot scenarios and unlock a new model for smart space services.

titleZh: 夏日送清凉，西瓜暖人心｜望潮创新 & 领擎机器人暖心慰问万科物业
titleEn: Bringing coolness in the summer, watermelons warm the heart | Wangchao Innovation & Lingqing Robotics send heartfelt greetings to Vanke Property
excerptZh: 近日，盛夏酷暑，热浪袭人。持续的高温天气席卷全城，望潮创新携手领擎机器人，联合走进万科物业，暖心开展“夏日送清凉·暖心慰坚守”公益慰问活动。作为本次公益行动的主导发起方，望潮创新以实际行动致敬酷暑之下坚守岗位的万科物业一线工作人员，用清甜好物送去夏日凉意，以企业温度回馈一线坚守，彰显品牌初心与社会责任。
excerptEn: Recently, in the height of summer, the scorching heat waves have been relentless. The continuous high temperatures have swept across the city, and Wangchao Innovation, together with Lingqing Robotics, paid a visit to Vanke Property to thoughtfully carry out the 'Sending Coolness in Summer · Warmly Caring for Those Who Stay' charity event. As the main initiator of this public welfare action, Wangchao Innovation showed respect to the front-line Vanke Property staff who stick to their posts under the scorching heat, bringing a touch of summer coolness with sweet treats, and giving back to those on the front line with a warm corporate touch, highlighting the brand's original intention and social responsibility.

titleZh: 政企同心促发展|互联网产业园发展服务中心领导莅临望潮创新机器人指导工作
titleEn: Government and Enterprises Unite for Development | Leaders from the Internet Industrial Park Development & Service Center Visit Wangchao Innovation Robotics for Guidance
excerptZh: 今日，互联网产业园发展服务中心领导一行莅临望潮创新考察调研。考察团深入企业研发与展示一线，全面了解公司技术研发、产品落地与发展规划，倾听企业发展诉求，为企业创新发展提指引、鼓干劲。望潮创新核心管理团队陪同考察。

titleZh: 湖州莫干山高新区考察团莅临我司 共探智能运维技术创新与产业融合
titleEn: Inspection Delegation from Huzhou Moganshan High-Tech Zone Visits Our Company to Explore Technological Innovation in Intelligent Operation & Maintenance and Industrial Integration
excerptZh: 湖州莫干山高新区管委会一行领导莅临杭州望潮创新科技有限公司（以下简称“望潮科技”）考察交流。望潮科技对此次“政企研”联动考察高度重视，公司管理层及核心研发团队全程陪同，并就公司在商用清洁机器人领域的最新成果进行了深入展示与汇报。

titleZh: 实景见证实力 科技驱动落地|韩国 AMANO、昆山沪光、杭州创投协会先后来访，实地观摩望潮全系列智能清洁机器人
titleEn: Seeing real results, powered by technology | South Korea's AMANO, Kunshan Huguang, and Hangzhou Venture Capital Association visited one after another to check out Wangchao's full range of smart cleaning robots in person
excerptZh: 韩国AMANO、昆山沪光汽车电器股份有限公司、杭州创投协会团队先后莅临总部，核心专项考察望潮创新地面清洁机器人、商用卫生间专用清洁机器人两大主力产品，实地观摩设备全自主无人作业流程，并结合自身产业资源、应用场景、供应链体系与资本赋能优势，开展深度技术交流与合作探讨。
excerptEn: Teams from Korea's AMANO, Kunshan Huguang Auto Electrical Co., Ltd., and the Hangzhou Venture Capital Association visited our headquarters one after another. They took a close look at Wangchao Innovation's two main products: the ground cleaning robot and the commercial restroom cleaning robot. They observed the fully autonomous, unmanned operation process on site, and, combining their own industry resources, application scenarios, supply chain systems, and capital advantages, engaged in in-depth technical exchanges and discussions about potential cooperation.

titleZh: 三展联动！望潮创新携全系列具身智能产品，领跑商用机器人产业新赛道
titleEn: Triple exhibition synergy! WangChao Innovation is leading the way in the commercial robotics industry with its full range of embodied intelligent products.
excerptZh: 五月盛会启幕，科技热潮涌动！作为全球商用机器人领域以具身智能为核心驱动力的创新者，望潮创新将开启“双线并行、三展联动”模式，同步亮相杭州、越南两大战场，携全系列核心产品与前沿技术，奔赴三场行业盛会，展现中国智造的实力与风采，共探机器人产业的无限可能。从杭州的具身智能赛事比拼、人形机器人前沿展演，到越南的智慧物流海外拓展，望潮创新以技术为核、以场景为基，全方位呈现具身智能在多领域的落地成果，诚邀行业伙伴、各界同仁莅临现场，共话合作、共启新篇！
excerptEn: The grand event in May kicks off, and the tech wave is surging! As a global innovator in commercial robotics driven by embodied intelligence, Wangchao Innovation is launching a 'dual-track, tri-show' approach, making simultaneous appearances in two major arenas: Hangzhou and Vietnam. Bringing our full range of core products and cutting-edge technologies, we’ll be heading to three industry events to showcase the strength and charm of Chinese innovation, exploring the limitless possibilities of the robotics industry. From embodied intelligence competitions and humanoid robot showcases in Hangzhou to smart logistics expansion overseas in Vietnam, Wangchao Innovation puts technology at the core and applications at the center, fully demonstrating how embodied intelligence is being applied across various fields. We warmly invite industry partners and colleagues from all walks of life to join us on-site to discuss collaboration and start a new chapter together!

titleZh: 广交会现场直击|领导关怀莅临,望潮创新收获满满
titleEn: Live from the Canton Fair | Leadership visits with care, Wangchao Innovation reaps abundant rewards
excerptZh: 第139 届中国进出口商品交易会（广交会）在广州盛大启幕。作为联通全球贸易、展示中国智造的重要窗口，本届广交会汇聚海内外优质企业，共促经贸合作、共话产业创新。望潮创新携旗下望潮 C1、C2、C3 商用清洁机器人及仓储 AGV 智能装备重磅亮相，以成熟的技术方案、落地的场景应用与稳定的产品性能，凭借前沿技术与创新方案吸引海内外客商广泛关注，展会洽谈成果丰硕。
excerptEn: The 139th China Import and Export Fair (Canton Fair) grandly opened in Guangzhou. As an important window connecting global trade and showcasing Chinese innovation, this year's fair brought together high-quality companies from home and abroad to promote economic cooperation and discuss industry innovation. Wangchao Innovation made a splash with its Wangchao C1, C2, C3 commercial cleaning robots and warehouse AGV smart equipment. With mature technical solutions, practical applications, and stable product performance, their cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions attracted widespread attention from domestic and international visitors, making the exhibition meetings very successful.

titleZh: 望潮C1机器人亮相展会 以自研技术推动商用清洁智能化
titleEn: Octopus C1 Debuts at Exhibition — Proprietary Technology Drives Smart Commercial Cleaning
excerptZh: 望潮C1空间具身清洁机器人在展会现场展示了地面洗吹一体与全域类人手清洁能力，受到行业专家高度评价。
excerptEn: The Octopus C1 spatial embodied cleaning robot demonstrated its floor wash-dry and full-area human-like hand cleaning capabilities, receiving high praise from industry experts.
